title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Sharp Consultancy is working with a growing business based in Penistone who are looking to appoint an experienced Accounts Assistant to join their finance team.

This is a genuinely varied role that would suit someone who enjoys having responsibility across different areas of finance rather than being restricted to one part of the function.

Working closely with the Group Financial Controller, you'll have involvement across sales ledger, credit control, invoicing, customer accounts, reporting and month-end finance, as well as working closely with customers and internal teams.

What will you be doing?

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and allocating daily customer receipts and bank transactions
- Managing customer accounts and carrying out credit control
- Investigating and resolving payment and account queries
- Raising daily customer invoices and credit notes
- Producing commercial and export invoices
- Managing customer queries and supporting order processing
- Carrying out credit checks on new customers
- Working with the Sales Director around credit limits and payment terms
- Producing weekly customer and management reports
- Supporting month-end processes and account reconciliations
- Posting intercompany transactions and assisting with VAT reporting
- Processing customer credit card payments
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation

What are we looking for?

You'll ideally have 2 years' experience within a finance or accounts environment, with a good understanding of sales ledger and credit control.

You'll also need:
- Previous experience using Sage accounting software or similar system
- Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Good numerical and analytical ability
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- A proactive, organised and questioning approach

Why consider the role?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant who wants a varied finance role with real ownership and responsibility. You'll be working closely with senior members of the finance team while gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting processes.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
A modern, cloud focused accountancy practice in Sheffield is looking to appoint an Assistant Accountant to its growing team. The firm has a very flexible approach to how and where people work, with a relaxed but professional culture and a strong focus on using technology to provide an efficient service to clients.

You will join an established accounts team and take responsibility for a varied portfolio, including a significant client operating within the property and construction sector. This role requires someone who is comfortable managing work from start to finish and dealing directly with clients. Previous CIS experience is essential, alongside a good working knowledge of Xero.

Responsibilities
- Manage the day to day accounting requirements for a portfolio of clients
- Take ownership of work from initial records through to completion
- Prepare year end accounts for a range of owner managed businesses
- Prepare and submit VAT returns
- Handle CIS accounting and compliance requirements
- Work extensively with Xero and other cloud accounting systems
- Respond to client queries and maintain regular client contact
- Build a strong working relationship with a key property and construction client
- Assist with client payroll requirements, with training available where required
- Work closely with bookkeeping and accounts colleagues across the wider team

Candidate Profile
- Previous experience within an accountancy practice or a relevant construction or property finance environment
- Practical CIS experience is essential
- Confident user of Xero
- AAT qualified or studying towards completion would be well suited, although experience will also be considered
- Experience preparing VAT returns and year end accounts
- Comfortable dealing directly with clients and handling routine queries independently
- Able to manage workload effectively when working remotely
- Payroll experience would be useful but is not essential as training can be provided

Package and Working Pattern
- £30,000 to £33,000+, dependent on experience
- Profit share bonus scheme with strong historic payouts
- Very flexible hybrid working with the option to divide time between home and the Sheffield office
- No fixed requirement for particular office days, with the team typically meeting in person around two to three days per week
- Flexible working hours to accommodate personal and family commitments
- Standard workplace pension
- City centre office environment with support towards parking costs where applicable
- Relaxed dress code and a modern approach to working practices

IPS Finance has 45 years' experience in the Yorkshire accountancy recruitment market. We have built our business on long term relationships with both individuals and clients in all sectors, bringing real benefits to all concerned. title: Credit Control / Accounts Assistant
description:
Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant

Overview

Our client is a well known Sheffield-based manufacturing business with a long, proud history.

We are recruiting for Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant to join their Sheffield team on site. The role combines customer credit control with day-to-day accounts work, supporting invoicing, payment allocation and month-end tasks. You will work closely with the finance team to maintain accurate accounts, reduce overdue debt and ensure timely reconciliation.

Key responsibilities
- Manage customer accounts and proactively chase overdue invoices to reduce days sales outstanding.
- Prepare and issue invoices, credit notes and customer statements accurately and promptly.
- Allocate customer receipts and reconcile bank transactions and ledgers.
- Support month-end close with account reconciliations and assisting with journal entries.
- Maintain accurate credit records, assess customer credit risk and raise queries where needed.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience in credit control and general accounts administration.
- Excellent numeracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident use of accounting software and spreadsheets.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills with customers and internal teams.
- AAT or equivalent accounting qualification desirable or working towards one.

Package and benefits
- £28k to £30k (negotiable)
- Study support for accountancy qualifications

Next step
- Submit CV to the Shillito Group consultant for initial review.
- Telephone screening with the recruiter to discuss suitability and availability.
- Interview.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk
Sheffield - Full Time, Permanent (Hybrid Working)

A Purchase Ledger role with a little more to it

We're looking for an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk to join a leading organisation, based in Sheffield to support their busy finance team and take ownership of the day-to-day purchase ledger process, whilst also supporting with a wider range of transactional finance activities.

This is a great role for someone who enjoys the detail and accuracy that comes with Purchase Ledger, but doesn't want to be limited in their responsibilities. You'll become an important part of the team, working closely with colleagues across the business and getting involved in different areas as you develop.

Duties will include:
- Processing and coding purchase invoices
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery notes
- Setting up and maintaining supplier accounts
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations
- Managing supplier queries and resolving invoice discrepancies
- Preparing and assisting with payment runs
- Ensuring the purchase ledger is accurate and up to date
- Supporting month-end activities and reconciliations
- Assisting with wider transactional finance duties across the team
- Providing support with general finance administration and ad-hoc finance tasks

We're looking for someone who already has Purchase Ledger experience and understands the importance of accuracy, organisation and keeping on top of deadlines.

You'll be comfortable dealing with suppliers, able to investigate and resolve queries and confident working through a high volume of invoices where required. Just as importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys being part of a team and is happy to get involved outside of your core responsibilities.

This would suit someone who is looking for a varied transactional finance role, where they can use their existing Purchase Ledger experience whilst continuing to broaden their knowledge across finance.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
